resource.title: Microelectronic Devices and Circuits (MIT 6.012, Fall 2005) — MIT OpenCourseWare
resource.access: 免费，无需注册（MIT OpenCourseWare）；页面标注讲座每周 2 次、每次 1 小时
resource.covers: 覆盖器件→放大电路主干：半导体物理、pn 二极管、MOS 电容、BJT、MOSFET 的大信号与小信号（增量）模型，以及用这些模型做线性放大电路分析、含 SPICE 设计项目。不覆盖简介里的功率放大器、振荡器、稳压电源，负反馈与差分放大器只在电路分析层面涉及，不作为课程主题。

courses.scope_text: Experimental laboratory explores the design, construction, and debugging of analog electronic circuits. Lectures and laboratory projects in the first half of the course investigate the performance characteristics of semiconductor devices (diodes, BJTs, and MOSFETs) and functional analog building blocks, including single-stage amplifiers, op amps, small audio amplifier, filters, converters, sensor circuits, and medical electronics (ECG, pulse-oximetry).

This course covers the fundamental circuit and device concepts needed to understand analog integrated circuits. After an overview of the basic properties of semiconductors, the p-n junction and MOS capacitors are described and the MOSFET is modeled as a large-signal device. Two port small-signal amplifiers and their realization using single stage and multistage CMOS building blocks are discussed. Sinusoidal steady-state signals are introduced and the techniques of phasor analysis are developed, including impedance and the magnitude and phase response of linear circuits. The frequency responses of single and multi-stage amplifiers are analyzed. Differential amplifiers are introduced.
courses.hours_text: Units: 4; Fall/Spring: 3 hours of lecture, 1 hour of discussion, and 3 hours of laboratory per week

courses.scope_text: Course Objectives: A: Semiconductor Physics - Explain and apply basic concepts of semiconductor physics relevant to devices B: Semiconductor Devices - Describe, explain, and analyze the operation of important semiconductor devices in terms of their physical structure C: Physics-based Models ... D: Circuit Analysis - Analyze and design microelectronic circuits for linear amplifier and digital applications E: Design ...
courses.hours_text: Lectures: 2 sessions / week, 1 hour / session; Recitations: 2 sessions / week, 1 hour / session

notes: 另核对到 Stanford EE 101B Circuits II（https://bulletin.stanford.edu/courses/ee-101b）：先修 EE 101A + EE 102A + (CME 102 或 MATH 53)，内容“Modeling and analysis of analog gain stages, frequency response, feedback. Filtering and analog to digital conversion. Fundamentals of circuit simulation.”，4 units；与上文 M.2.1、H.1.3 的 extra_prereqs 一致，因每技能限 3 门未列入 courses。H.2.5 在三门课的先修里都没有出现：MIT 6.2040/6.2080 与 Berkeley EE 105 都把器件特性放在本课内讲，所以“半导体器件与微电子基础”作为本技能的必需前置在课程证据上不被支持，宜视为并列或后续。N.1.2 的证据来自 MIT 6.012 的先修 8.02（Physics II），MIT 6.2040 的 6.2000 本身也要求 Physics II (GIR)。
